title: gpg key data
description: Shape of .chezmoidata/gpg.yaml. Merged into the same template data as hosts.yaml. Validates structure only -- the trust level lives on the 1Password document, so nothing here can check it, and no schema can tell whether a declared document exists. tools/check-consistency C27 covers the private-key invariants.

vault.description: 1Password vault holding one document per declared key, each titled after the key's `name`.

warn_days.description: Print a renewal warning once the private key expires within this many days. Reporting only -- the import never re-fetches on its own.

keys.description: Flat list, one entry per imported key.

private.description: The document holds a secret key. Exactly one entry may set it, and that entry must declare a fingerprint (C27). `false` is rejected on purpose -- every consumer reads this with hasKey, so absence is how a public key says so.

fingerprint.description: Full 40-character fingerprint. Declared only on the private key, which git signs with.
